# A11oy Proof Registry

> A separately hosted first-party evidence registry for A11oy, published by SZL Holdings.

Authoritative public paths:
- Evidence homepage: https://a11oy.net/
- Investor and developer diligence room: https://a11oy.net/diligence/
- Governed product console gateway: https://a11oy.net/chat/
- Governed code gateway: https://a11oy.net/code/
- Machine-readable evidence contract: https://a11oy.net/evidence.json
- Static-surface scope: https://a11oy.net/api/build-info/
- Static reachability only: https://a11oy.net/readyz/
- Source: https://github.com/szl-holdings/a11oy-net
- Product source: https://github.com/szl-holdings/a11oy
- Public artifact registry: https://huggingface.co/SZLHOLDINGS
- Security reporting: https://a11oy.net/.well-known/security.txt

Truth boundary:
- This static site's availability does not establish A11oy product-runtime readiness.
- A link or HTTP response does not prove capability, safety, quality, or uptime.
- Public Hugging Face metadata is not an authenticated private inventory.
- Preserve MEASURED, REPORTED, MODELED, HEURISTIC, UNKNOWN, and UNAVAILABLE labels.
- Product runtime and receipt-verifier state must be observed at their own live sources.
- The /chat/ and /code/ pages are static cross-domain handoffs, not product-runtime execution surfaces.
